answer: Agents surveying sparrow nests on a marble seawall and coral cover on the reef get one paid survey slot per certified camera each round. The registry issues one certificate per secure element, whose key cannot be exported. To claim a slot, the camera signs a fresh round nonce. The ledger verifies the certificate and signature and rejects a second claim for that camera in the round. To claim 100 slots, an operator must buy or rent 100 certified cameras. Creating 100 agent accounts adds no slots.
